boundary_classes.description: Direct Jira Cloud REST API v3 over HTTPS for JQL searches and worklog retrieval.

properties.notes: Probed live Jira REST endpoints returning HTTP 200, 400, 401, and 404.
Verified Jira error envelope schema containing errorMessages array and errors map.
Captured live rate limit headers including ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-limit.

properties.absence_reason: Stateless Jira API basic authentication tokens are used per request without session expiration lifecycle.
Static API token credentials loaded from environment variables without automated in-flight rotation.
Single user client scope where all queries operate under identical currentUser permissions.
Direct HTTPS communication to Jira Cloud API domain without intermediate proxy redirects.

boundary_classes.description: Local jira CLI subprocess used for command verification and fallback probing.

properties.notes: Verified CLI process returns exit code 0 on success and non-zero on error.
Verified raw CLI stdout emits parseable JSON arrays without framing corruption.

properties.absence_reason: The raw CLI flag executes non-interactively without ANSI terminal escape styling codes.
Standard UTF-8 character encoding is inherited directly from system runtime environment.
Arguments are passed as discrete token arrays avoiding shell quoting or terminator ambiguities.
CLI queries are fast synchronous operations completing before signal trap handling is needed.
Subprocess execution explicitly passes parent process environment without customized scrubbing.
CLI output streams directly via stdout pipes without temporary scratch file creation.
Jira CLI does not produce non-fatal diagnostic warning streams during standard raw JSON operations.

boundary_classes.description: Node.js HTTP request routing and query parameter parsing middleware.

properties.absence_reason: Read-only GET endpoints retrieve parameters from query strings without request body buffer parsing.

properties.notes: Query parser extracts and validates YYYY-MM month parameter before route dispatch.

properties.absence_reason: Responses are returned as complete discrete JSON payloads without chunked HTTP stream framing.
No inbound webhooks or cryptographic payload signatures are used in this application.

boundary_classes.absence_reason: The application is stateless and retrieves all timelog data on-demand from Jira without local database storage.
The application uses direct synchronous HTTP communication and does not use message queues or async message brokers.
The application does not interact with hardware sensors or peripheral device IO.
The application does not query LLM model endpoints or AI inference services.

boundary_classes.description: Plain HTML and TypeScript DOM runtime rendering timelog views and handling month navigation.

properties.notes: DOM rendering updates UI components on data receipt and handles error presentation.

properties.absence_reason: Vanilla TypeScript frontend without React StrictMode double invocation behavior.
Plain HTML DOM rendering does not use portal mounting abstractions.
Standard web page without browser device permissions or modal dialog requirements.
Desktop browser web page runtime without mobile background memory eviction lifecycle.

boundary_classes.description: Integration test fixtures and boundary parity verification harness.

properties.absence_reason: Verification tests use real system time or explicit ISO date strings without synthetic timer flushing.
Verification test queries are strictly bounded by explicit calendar month parameters.

properties.notes: Differential parity verification between mock fixture responses and live Jira REST API schema.

boundary_classes.absence_reason: No other external or custom boundary classes are required for this application.
